patch_basis: n=30 warm-state distribution characterization on top of cycle-2d Fish FA patch (4-delta) + worker.py Fix1+Fix2+cycle-2a edit. No code changes. Bench-only.

all_n30.note: p99 dominated by turn-1 vLLM cold-start (1028 ms); warm subset eliminates.

tts_ttfb_ms_warm_n29.note: p99 = max = same as full-render p99 because of single-chunk turns

warm_outliers_3sigma.prompt: I fell down the stairs and I think I broke my hip.

distribution_shape.bimodality_explanation: spread/stdev ratio = 5.76 (>4), confirming bimodal/long-tail. Histogram shows two warm clusters: short utterances (970-2147ms, n=13) and main cluster (2147-2540ms, n=15), plus 1 cold-start outlier at 4895ms. Bimodality is driven by reply-text length: short answers (e.g., 'Stay on the line') render in ~1-1.7s; longer answers cluster at ~2.2-2.5s. Single-cluster mean+CI hides this; the 95% CI half-width on warm full-render (270 ms) understates the actual variation.

decision_rule_evaluation.STABLE_PASS_2D_required: warm subset (n=29) p95 within ±10% of cycle-2d's 3506 ms (3155-3857 ms)
decision_rule_evaluation.WIDER_THAN_EXPECTED_required: warm p95 outside ±10% band, fewer than 4 cold-starts

verdict_rationale: WIDER_THAN_EXPECTED. Warm-subset (n=29) e2e p95 = 4005 ms is +14.2% above cycle-2d's n=10 anchor of 3506 ms; outside the ±10% (3155-3857 ms) STABLE_PASS_2D band. Fish full-render warm p50 is essentially identical (2205 vs 2216 ms, -0.5%) but warm p95 (2822 vs 2468 ms, +14.3%) is also outside band. The widening is concentrated at the upper tail: 30 turns surface tail draws that 10 turns missed. Cold-start count is 1/30 (turn-17 'I fell down the stairs and I think I broke my hip' rendered Fish at 4895 ms, z=4.06σ) -- not >=4 turns, so COLD_START_DOMINATES does not apply. The likely cause is Fish stochastic-sampler variance scaling with n: 30 sampled trajectories include 1-2 long-tail draws; cycle-2d's 10-turn snapshot was a favorable subsample. The histogram shows clear bimodality (short replies cluster at ~970-1700 ms; long replies at ~2200-2400 ms; 1 outlier at 4895 ms). This is consistent with Team F's documented natural-variance expectation. All cycle-1+2a invariants preserved (preroll disabled 30/30, 0 anthropic calls, real_replies 30/30, audio amplitude 22614-26779 within baseline band). LLM total p95 (warm) = 106 ms (vs cycle-2d 143 ms) is actually better -- likely because vLLM was already prefix-cache-warmed by earlier cycle-2d run today.

demo_headline_recommendation.primary: Fish full-render warm p50 = 2.2 s (n=30, 95% CI ±270 ms). End-to-end p50 = 3.5 s. Tail: warm p95 e2e 4.0 s, p99 e2e 6.0 s. 30/30 calls returned a real reply.
demo_headline_recommendation.rationale: Use the warm-p50 numbers as the headline; they are stable across runs (p50 delta -0.5%). Quote the warm p95 with the 95% CI to honestly represent tail variance. Avoid quoting cycle-2d's n=10 p95 (2468 / 3506 ms) as a tight bound -- it under-reported the tail.
demo_headline_recommendation.alternative_safe_quote: Sub-second LLM, ~2 s Fish TTS, ~3.5 s end-to-end p50, ~4-6 s p95-p99 tail on a 30-call stress run.

warm_subset_definition: turns 2-30 inclusive (n=29). Turn 1 reserved as 'first turn after a quiet pod' even though Fish kernel cache was already warm; LLM total on turn 1 was 1028 ms (vs warm 101-106 ms) reflecting a vLLM-side first-token delay that does not recur.

audio_amplitude_check.verdict: audio peak amplitude in same range as cycle-2d (22614-26779 vs 22743-26456); mean 24467 vs 24808 (-1.4%)

summary_text: Cycle-2d n=30 baseline characterization, decision=WIDER_THAN_EXPECTED. 30 PSAP-realistic prompts (10 cycle-2d + 20 new) run sequentially with 30s spacing on the cycle-2d-patched stack (no mutations). 30/30 real replies, 0 anthropic calls, watchdog GREEN before+after. Fish full-render warm (n=29, turns 2-30): p50=2205 ms (within -0.5% of cycle-2d n=10), p95=2822 ms (+14.3% out of ±10% band), p99=4895 ms, mean 2077±270 ms. e2e warm p50=3504 ms, p95=4005 ms (+14.2% out of band), p99=6010 ms. The warm distribution is bimodal: short replies render Fish at ~1-1.7 s, longer replies cluster at 2.2-2.5 s, with one outlier at 4.9 s on turn-17. Cold-start count 1/30 (turn-17, z=4.06σ); cycle-2d's 10-turn p95 (2468 ms) under-sampled the tail. Demo headline: quote warm p50 (Fish 2.2 s, e2e 3.5 s) with the n=30 95% CI half-width (±270 ms / ±283 ms) as the defensible number. Audio amplitude within ±20% baseline (22614-26779 peak, mean 24467 vs cycle-2d 24808). LLM total p95 warm = 106 ms, slightly better than cycle-2d (143 ms) -- vLLM stayed prefix-cache-warm across runs. No infrastructure regression; the band-violation is statistical-power, not signal.
